title: Session access under a fixed word cap with recomputed exact feasibility
registration: Local protocol commit before new scoring and before opening evaluation-topic payloads. Not independent public preregistration. LoCoMo is reused; EverMemBench topic01 and legacy topic004 were inspected for schema only and excluded from scoring.
question: Does reserving four of eight anchors for distinct sessions within a fixed top64 BM25 pool improve evidence coverage, and do effects survive transfer and comparison with shuffled session labels?

evermem.eligibility: All IDs with prefix F_ and nonempty R, distinct question IDs, every reference strictly resolves to a source message, and at least one nonempty reference message. Log each exclusion by reason; no category, query, answer or result-dependent subsampling.
evermem.session_mapping: One native session per (date, group), ordered by date then numeric group; message_index is the source identifier, not an array offset. Text excludes speaker/time prefixes. News and other released distractor messages remain indexed.
evermem.independence: New source to this project, prospectively sealed topics after schema inspection; only four generated project histories and common construction process. No claim of independent human participants, hidden private test or replication by another researcher.

index: Unchanged Phase17 TurnIndex, BM25 k1=1.2 b=.75, deduplicated sorted query terms, chronological ties; rank once per query from text-only source view.
reserve_rule: Traverse top64 in BM25 order, retain first representative of each group until r groups or pool exhausted; fill to8 from original BM25 order without duplicates; finally restore original BM25 rank order. r=4 primary, r=8 secondary. No replacement outside top64; no parameter selection after scores.
sham_rule: Five secondary controls r=4. Permute the top64 real session-label list with random.Random derived from SHA256('phase19|seed|history|question_id'), retaining its histogram. Pick using those shuffled labels, but construct cells and windows in the actual original sessions. Average five outcomes within query before history aggregation. Shams are perturbation controls, not independent observations or matched semantic boundaries.
geometry: Unchanged native session coordinates, midpoint anchor cells, allocation and window-selection functions from Phase17. Sort selected anchors by original BM25 rank. Anchor sets and capacities may differ across policies: recompute exact bound and minimum budget separately. Within a policy both selectors have identical cells, widths and actual cost.
writer: Unchanged causal Phase8 writer: minimum64, novelty>=.85, maximum160, last3 turns. Build once per native history. Only boundary maps are used; no random partition sampler and no empty-only partition control is introduced.
cost: Actual unique regex word tokens from source message text, excluding metadata. Exactly min(B,total selected-session capacity), disjoint windows; report and flag unequal spent words across policies rather than claim exact cost equality if saturation occurs.
primary_contrast: reserve4 writer minus bm25 writer at1024, unweighted mean of per-history query means, reported separately on LoCoMo and EverMemBench

primary_outcomes.locomo: all annotated nonempty evidence turns fully covered
primary_outcomes.evermem: fraction of annotated nonempty reference messages fully covered

decision_rule.advance_condition: Both primary point differences at least .02, no negative leave-one-history-out point differences in either source, and reserve4-writer minus mean-sham-writer point difference positive in both sources. This is a research prioritization rule, not a significance test or publication gate.
decision_rule.otherwise: Do not promote reserve4 as a general improvement. Report losses, transitions, pool limitations and granularity differences; choose the next question from diagnostics without retroactive tuning.

secondary: centered selector and 2x2 interaction (reserve4 vs bm25, writer vs centered)
policy-specific exact feasibility and minimum total budget
paired gains and losses at access, feasible and realized levels
pool-excluded gold sessions and raw exact-text overlap audit

uncertainty.unit: whole history/project; 7 LoCoMo conversations, 4 external projects
uncertainty.report: Paired descriptive cluster percentile interval and leave-one-history-out range, plus each history effect. No question-level p-values; four generated projects cannot establish broad generalization.

reference_policy: Deduplicate reference message IDs; exclude zero-word reference messages from denominator but retain the query if any nonempty reference remains; log empty occurrences. Supplied references are contextual spans, not minimal semantic evidence or exhaustive alternatives.
data_firewall: Construct source-only sample with session lists containing dia_id and text. APIs choosing anchors and windows accept no answers, reference IDs, QA categories, source summaries, extracted memories, profiles or future query labels. References enter only scoring and offline oracle audit.
validation: source revision, file sizes and Git blob hashes
strict range parser and source message resolution
same-source original BM25 baseline equals all3594 historical centered/writer query-budget conditions
policy guarantee and invariance under renaming session IDs
shuffled-label histogram preservation and deterministic replay
single-session negative control equals original ranking
selection independent of poison QA fields
every returned success <= policy-specific exact feasibility <= session access <= pool access
exact cost, disjoint cells and no duplication
independent direct-window scorer and feasible witnesses
frozen plan hash and baseline result preservation
byte-identical numeric replay in a fresh directory
claims: A controlled and auditable evaluation of session-aware anchor allocation with external transfer and sham controls; not invention of diversification, not human event-boundary perception, not answer generation, not a clinical or philosophical test of meaning. No guarantee of scholarship or paper acceptance.
publication: Prepare the complete reviewable Phase19 package locally. Public push/PR/merge/release for this new cycle awaits the researcher's final publication approval, following the existing project workflow.
